title: Mobile app shell — Pack 2
notes: Replace the phone hamburger as primary navigation with a persistent safe-area-aware bottom navigation bar.
Give operators Today, Jobs, Time and Safety as primary tabs, with lower-frequency tools under More.
Give clients Home, Jobs and Invoices as primary tabs, with Contacts, Company and account tools under More.
Give manager and office roles up to four permission-aware high-frequency tabs plus More, so accounting, mechanics, dispatchers and safety users do not see inaccessible primary tabs.
Turn More into a mobile bottom sheet containing lower-frequency navigation, notifications, settings, demo-role switching and sign out.
Remove duplicate primary links from the More sheet on phones while retaining the complete navigation list on desktop.
Reserve safe-area space below page content, move demo controls above the mobile bar, surface notification counts on More and remove the old floating mobile hamburger spacing.
Hide primary navigation during full-screen modal/editor workflows and remove all Northborn navigation chrome from printable documents.
